```{r libraries}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r cargar_clase1}
load("../output/clase1_clustering.RData")
table(Idents(obj))
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Comparar el clúster 0 con el resto
markers_0 <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = "0",
                         only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25,
                         logfc.threshold = 0.25)

markers_0_fdr <- subset(markers_0, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1)
markers_0_fdr %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% slice_head(n=1)
FeaturePlot(obj, features = "Fam84a", reduction = "umap")
VlnPlot(obj, features = "Fam84a", pt.size = 0.1)
```

```{r}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE,
                          min.pct = 0.25,logfc.threshold = 0.25)
head(markers)

# cuantos marcadores se identificaron por cluster
markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% count(cluster, name = "n_markers")
```

```{r seleccionar_marcadores}
# Seleccionar marcadores candidatos
markers_sig <- markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, pct.1 > pct.2)

# Seleccionar los 3 genes con mayor log2FC por clúster
top3 <- markers_sig %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

top3 %>%
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj)

genes_plot <- unique(top3$gene)
```

```{r dotplot_marcadores, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
DotPlot(obj, features = genes_plot) + RotatedAxis()
```

```{r umap_marcador, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
gen <- genes_plot[1]
FeaturePlot(obj, features = gen, reduction = "umap")
```

```{r violin_marcador, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
VlnPlot(obj, features = gen, pt.size = 0)
```

```{r heatmap_marcadores, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
obj_heatmap <- ScaleData(obj, features = genes_plot, verbose = FALSE)
DoHeatmap(obj_heatmap, features = genes_plot) + NoLegend()
```

```{r instalar_referencia, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("scRNAseq", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r cargar_referencia}
library(scRNAseq)

# Referencia de mesencéfalo embrionario de ratón
sce_ref <- LaMannoBrainData("mouse-embryo", ensembl = FALSE, location = FALSE)
sce_ref <- sce_ref[, !is.na(sce_ref$Cell_type)]
rownames(sce_ref) <- make.unique(rownames(sce_ref))

referencia <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as(assay(sce_ref, "counts"), "dgCMatrix"),
                                 project = "LaManno")
referencia$cell_type <- as.character(sce_ref$Cell_type)
table(referencia$cell_type)
```

```{r preparar_referencia}
referencia <- NormalizeData(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- FindVariableFeatures(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- ScaleData(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- RunPCA(referencia, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r buscar_anchors}
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
Idents(obj) <- "seurat_clusters"
length(intersect(rownames(obj), rownames(referencia)))

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = referencia, query = obj,
                                reference.reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
```

```{r transferir_identidades}
pred <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors,
                     refdata = referencia$cell_type, dims = 1:20)
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, metadata = pred)
obj$cell_type <- obj$predicted.id
```

```{r visualizar_anotacion, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
```

```{r concordancia_clusters}
concordancia <- prop.table(table(Cluster = obj$seurat_clusters,
                                Tipo_predicho = obj$cell_type), margin = 1) * 100
round(concordancia, 1)
```

```{r heatmap_anotacion, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
porcentajes <- as.data.frame(concordancia)
ggplot(porcentajes, aes(Cluster, Tipo_predicho, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#377EB8", mid = "white", high = "#E41A1C",
                       midpoint = 50, limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 50, 100), name = "% células") +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Tipo predicho") + theme_minimal()
```

```{r confianza_violin, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# El puntaje de transferencia no es una probabilidad calibrada
summary(obj$prediction.score.max)
VlnPlot(obj, features = "prediction.score.max", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0)
```

```{r confianza_umap, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
FeaturePlot(obj, features = "prediction.score.max", reduction = "umap") |
  FeaturePlot(obj, features = "prediction.score.max", reduction = "tsne")
```


```{r clases_generales}
grupos <- c(
  mNbM = "Neuroblastos", mNbML2 = "Neuroblastos",
  mNbL2 = "Neuroblastos", mNbDA = "Neuroblastos",
  mNProg = "Progenitores neuronales",
  mRgl1 = "Glía radial", mRgl2 = "Glía radial",
  mEpen = "Ependimarias", mMgl = "Microglía",
  mEndo = "Vasculares", mPeric = "Vasculares", mUnk = "No asignadas"
)
obj$cell_class <- unname(grupos[obj$cell_type])
```

```{r umap_clases, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_class", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
```

```{r recuperar_raton}
metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
# Los nombres de fila conservan Library_Barcode, igual que colnames(obj)
idx <- match(colnames(obj), rownames(metadata))
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))
obj$Mouse <- as.character(metadata$Mouse[idx])
table(obj$Mouse)
```

```{r composicion_celular}
conteos <- table(Muestra = obj$Mouse, Tipo_celular = obj$cell_class)
conteos
proporciones <- prop.table(conteos, margin = 1) * 100
round(proporciones, 1)
```

```{r barras_composicion, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
comp <- as.data.frame(prop.table(conteos, margin = 1))
ggplot(comp, aes(Muestra, Freq, fill = Tipo_celular)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Ratón", y = "Proporción celular", fill = "Tipo celular") + theme_minimal()
```

```{r generar_pseudobulk}
pseudo <- AggregateExpression(
  object = obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  group.by = c("Mouse", "cell_type"),
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA
dim(pseudo)
as.matrix(pseudo[1:10, 1:6])
```
